mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing amiodarone levels and QT prolongation risk; amiodarone may displace valproic acid from protein binding and inhibit its metabolism.
action: Monitor ECG for QT prolongation and arrhythmias; consider baseline and periodic monitoring of both drug levels; assess for amiodarone toxicity signs; adjust amiodarone dose if needed.
